title: Claude in Chrome and Your Other Apps

questions.prompt: Which browser does Claude in Chrome support?
questions.explanation: Claude in Chrome supports Google Chrome only, not other Chromium-based browsers and not mobile.

questions.prompt: Anthropic calls ____ injection the biggest risk facing browser-using AI tools.
questions.explanation: Prompt injection, hidden instructions in web content, can trick a browser agent into unintended actions. The risk isn't zero even with safety classifiers.

questions.prompt: Which are recommended practices for using Claude in Chrome safely? Select all that apply.

options.text: Use a separate browser profile without sensitive accounts
Review proposed actions, especially on new websites
Stop the task if Claude drifts to unrelated sites or asks for sensitive data
Let it trade stocks while you sleep

questions.explanation: Use a separate profile, review actions, and stop at anything unexpected. Stock trading and investment transactions are prohibited uses.

questions.prompt: Match each surface to the job it fits best.

pairs.right: Auditing formulas in the open spreadsheet
Delegating a task from a team thread

questions.explanation: Choose the surface where the work already lives: the browser, the document, the team chat, or your phone.

questions.prompt: What can Claude for Google Workspace never do?

options.text: Share the file, give anyone access, or change its owner
Answer questions about the open document

questions.explanation: The sidebar edits only the open file, asks before edits by default, and can't share files, grant access, or change ownership.

questions.prompt: Order the steps for a safe first browser-agent task.

items.text: Save it as a shortcut once it works reliably
Open a separate Chrome profile without sensitive accounts
Switch to Manually approve for the first run
Put only the relevant tabs in Claude's tab group

questions.explanation: Isolate the profile, scope the tabs, review each action on the first run, and only reuse or schedule the task after it proves reliable.
